package.evidence: V2 loads a directory package with package.json name/exports and a default Plugin.define definition. The artifact root is that package, so shared MCP/hook/App/CLI outputs retain their existing relative paths.

marketplace.reason: OpenCode V2 directory plugins use discovery or the plugins array, not a native marketplace manifest. `opencode plugin add` manages global package plugins and is not a local directory install path.

rules.reason: No canonical rules lowering is implemented for OpenCode. Configured instructions exist, but this adapter does not claim they're equivalent to the canonical rule component.

agents.reason: The normalized application has no authored agent component to lower into V2 agents.

web.reason: V2 2.2.6 documents MCP tools/resources/prompts but no MCP Apps display surface. Serving an App resource does not prove an OpenCode UI renders it.

tasks.reason: The pinned MCP guide includes protocol revision selection but does not document task-augmented tools/call for plugin-generated servers.

commands.evidence: ctx.command.transform registers a native V2 command whose execute callback calls ctx.session.prompt. Argument substitution follows the V2 command template rules.

skills.evidence: ctx.skill.transform registers path-backed native V2 skills; this is not a copied portable-skill compatibility claim.

hostFrontmatter.reason: V2 uses path-derived IDs, description, and metadata.opencode/autoinvoke. Host-specific frontmatter from other targets is not forwarded.

markdownTokens.reason: No OpenCode V2 Skill Markdown interpolation syntax is documented at this pin.

evidence: 2026-11-12: installed @opencode/cli 2.2.6 invoked context.event.subscribe({types:['session.created'],signal}) for a real local plugin; session.create emitted sessionID and location.directory without a provider/model call, and abort+await stopped the loop in cleanup.
Creation alone does not distinguish resume or clear, so the native source is always startup and no model/session result channel is inferred.

session/end.reason: No V2 2.2.6 session-end hook is published.

agent/start.reason: Subagent definitions exist, but no V2 2.2.6 subagent-start domain hook is published.

agent/stop.reason: Subagent definitions exist, but no V2 2.2.6 subagent-stop domain hook is published.

agent/idle.reason: experimental.idle is session-idle, not a teammate-idle event.

workspace/open.reason: Plugin setup receives location context, not a per-workspace-open hook.

compact/before.reason: The V2 compaction hook lacks a reliable manual/auto trigger field needed by the canonical compact/before contract.

compact/after.reason: No V2 2.2.6 post-compaction hook is published.

permission/request.reason: permission.evaluate has action/resources/effect, not the canonical tool envelope; the adapter does not fabricate one.

permission/denied.reason: permission.evaluate does not run after an explicit configured deny, so it cannot observe canonical permission/denied.

config/change.reason: V2 config reload is not exposed as the canonical config/change envelope.

file/change.reason: No V2 2.2.6 file-change plugin hook is published.

model-switch/before.reason: session.switchModel is an API operation, not a before-model-switch hook.

model-switch/after.reason: session.switchModel is an API operation, not an after-model-switch hook.

stop/failure.reason: experimental.idle does not run after failure; the retry hook is not the canonical stop/failure event.

task/create.reason: No V2 2.2.6 task-created plugin hook is published.

task/complete.reason: No V2 2.2.6 task-completed plugin hook is published.

timeout.reason: V2 domain hook registration exposes no per-handler timeout option. Wrappers retain their internal execution timeouts but no native timeout is claimed.

toolMatchers.evidence: Tool hook callbacks expose event.tool; generated OpenCode callbacks apply canonical matchers before spawning a wrapper.

install.evidence: V2 auto-discovers package directories under project .opencode/plugins and the global config plugins directory. Agent Bundle copies its receipt-owned native package there rather than invoking the package-only global plugin add command.

current-response.sensitivityEvidence: 2026-11-12: V2 hook callbacks run in the OpenCode server process, but public text delivered through prompt/tool mutations is model-visible, so only internal content is advertised.

next-event.sensitivityEvidence: 2026-11-12: experimental.idle admits a synthetic message into the same execution, and text is model-visible.

directed-push.reason: 2026-11-12: No plugin-directed cross-actor delivery API is pinned.

host-toast.reason: 2026-11-12: No plugin-facing toast API is pinned for the server host.

mcp-inbox.sensitivityEvidence: 2026-11-12: Inbox identity is transport-derived and not authenticated by this host; secret content is withheld.

mcp-resource-updated.sensitivityEvidence: 2026-11-12: Resource update notices contain only the inbox URI.
